# voipms_forwarding (Data Source)

Reads a call forwarding by id (`getForwardings`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_forwarding" "mobile" {
  id = "1001"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Forwarding id.

### Read-Only

- `callerid_override` (String) Caller ID override.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `diversion_header` (Boolean) SIP Diversion header enabled.
- `dtmf_digits` (String) DTMF digits sent after answer.
- `pause` (String) Pause before DTMF.
- `phone_number` (String) Destination number.
